en: Low water exposes Nazi wreckage in Danube - salvage remains risky. Falling water levels on the Danube section near Prahovo expose Nazi warships. The EU is having 21 wrecks salvaged because they hinder shipping and remain dangerous.
la: Humilis aqua naufragia Nazi in Danubio exponit - salvagium manet periculosum. Gradus aquae cadentes in sectione Danubio prope Prahovo naves longas Rolandus exponunt. UE naufragia 21 salvari habet quod naves impediunt et periculosa manent.

en: Female in the morning, male in the evening – researchers solve the puzzle of the intersex avocado. The avocado is one of the world's most unusual fruit plants: its flowers change gender throughout the day. Researchers have now revealed the secret behind this unusual rhythm.
la: Femina mane, mas vesperi - investigatores aenigma intersex avocado solvunt. Avocado unus est rarissimus fructus plantarum mundi: flores eius per diem sexum mutant. Nunc investigatores secretum hunc modulum insolitum revelaverunt.

en: High harvest declines calculated: Climate change threatens this staple food more than expected. Rice feeds a large part of the world's population. But the grain is vulnerable to extreme heat. Previous models underestimate this effect of global warming. This could have consequences for the availability of the food.
la: Alta messis decrescit computata: Clima mutatio huic stapulae cibum magis quam expectata minatur. Oryza magnam partem incolarum mundi pascit. Sed granum vulnerabile est ad calorem maximum.
